entities.name: Person A

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The person in a white extravehicular suit leaning into view from the left in frame 0, with a rectangular attachment on top of the helmet, a relatively dark face, a circular shoulder patch, and the upper body and backpack cropped by the left edge.

entities.name: silver-gray gridded metal panel assembly

entities.name: planetary background
entities.identification: The large blue-and-white distant view behind the people and equipment, with a blue underlying surface, white cloud masses, and fine cloud patterns.

entities.name: black-gray angular equipment box
entities.identification: The angular box-like equipment in the lower-left foreground in frame 0, with a light-gray slanted top surface, a large dark side surface, and light-colored edges.
